create_xcit_model: create an XCiT model for image classification with configurable patch size, depth, and number of classes
build_xcit_transformer: build an XCATransformer with cross-covariance attention, local patch interaction, and feedforward layers
test_xc_attention: test the XCAttention module that uses cross-covariance attention with learnable temperature scaling
refactor_attention: refactor the Attention class to support context-aware attention with separate query and key-value projections
review_layer_scale: review the LayerScale class that applies depth-dependent initialization scaling to transformer layers
